modules.module_title: Oversee routine tasks of the household

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the interior of the house is clean and well- maintained at all times in an orderly fashion
organise and manage daily cleaning of the kitchen and other important areas of the household
supervise daily accomplishment of cleaning requirements of the household
maintain cleaning log including normal performance time values
oversee procurement of household goods such as grocery, supplies and other requested items
assure that all routine household supplies are always on hand and nothing that is foreseeable is overlooked
perform shopping and errands in accordance with employer’s guidelines such as shoe repairs/shine, pick up prescriptions, etc
prepare inventory of the household and restock things as needed
inspect the household on a daily basis for things that need repair such as appliances, cook ware etc
recommend and obtain appropriate equipment to perform everyday tasks of the household
perform or see that the laundry is accomplished
perform laundering and putting away clothing, or changing linens
oversee that the foot wear is being taken care off
maintain cars and other personal vehicles
handle simple house maintenance like changing air filters, light bulbs, diffusers, etc
perform pet care based on the requirement
prepare healthy and nutritious meals based on requirement and family’s acceptable eating standards and guidelines
note and bring to the employer about any exceptional conditions, issues and problems
ensure that telephone and door is answered timely and appropriately
ensure that the household is secure at all times

modules.module_title: Manage infrequent activities or tasks that occur on some special days in the household

pcs.pc_description: organize and coordinate for family and household events such as dinner parties
coordinate with event planners to make sure that all arrangements are made for special events
coordinate with vendors to ensure that all supplies needed for events are delivered on time
serve drinks and food based on the requirement
perform chauffeur duties as and when required
ensure that all the services run smoothly during events, such as weddings, get togethers etc
take care of any problems that arise during events, such as broken dishes or leaking toilets, while ensuring that guests do not notice any issues
purchase gifts or other event related items on employer’s behalf
make travel vacation and lodging arrangements
pack and unpack travellers’ luggage
schedule home maintenance and repair work, and supervise the project
accept and accomplish special assignments as chartered by employer
arrange all aspects of moving house if the client is moving

modules.module_title: Fulfil various administrative duties of the household

pcs.pc_description: develop proposed budgets for running the household under the supervision of the employer
manage and monitor the household budget
maintain financial records of the household
pay bills through different means
maintain household checking and petty cash accounts
keep an account of the expenses incurred and compare to the approved budget
approve purchases within established spending limits
maintain inventory of all furnishings and equipment in the house and order replacements when needed
manage the household’s schedules and calendars
make and arrange for personal and professional appointments on behalf of the family members
communicate with the employers' work assistants to coordinate schedules
ensure various equipment and appliances are well-maintained
carry out routine safety checks of household
monitor and report household maintenance and repair needs
provide oversight of the employer’s finances and valuables
recognize vulnerabilities and bring to the attention of employer
maintain records such as insurance records & contacts, staff backgrounds, vendors and contacts, medications in house, security arrangements and so on
perform all other miscellaneous tasks as requested by employer or, guests as confirmed by employer

modules.module_title: Communicate with others in an efficient manner

pcs.pc_description: interact with people at workplace in a polite and professional manner
listen actively to the issues or requirements and respond timely and appropriately
trust, support and respect people at workplace
offer friendly, courteous and hospitable service to others
avoid interrupting others while they talk
pass on appropriate information to others and in a time bound manner
seek and provide feedback to others on a regular basis
maintain clarity, honesty and transparency while communicating with others
respect the personal and professional space of people at workplace
maintain appropriate body language while communicating with others
respect people across all, age groups, genders, religions, and caste
empathize with the people with disability and elderly
offer support or help to a person with a disability and eldery, if asked
use inclusive language that is sensitive to people towards all gender, disability and age
ensure to adhere to the guidelines laid in Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act
report any violation of prevention of sexual harassment (POSH) rules immediately to the POSH committee
